description: Re-running the migration after it has already succeeded is detected as already_done and refused with a distinct, non-alarming message.
why_it_exists: A one-shot migration will be re-run by a human who is not sure it ran. Without the already_done branch the second run reports the same scary 'Column N is not empty' as a genuine collision, which is indistinguishable from data loss.

expect.refusal: Column N already holds the unmapped_facts_json header. Nothing to do.

assertions: already_done requires both that cell N1 equals 'unmapped_facts_json' and that it is the only non-blank cell in the range.
A rerun still writes nothing - already_done is reported through the Refused branch, not treated as safe_to_write.
The already-done refusal text differs from the collision refusal text so the two outcomes are never confused.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
